results.title: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy highlights welfare initiatives at Parkal public meeting
results.description: At a Parkal meeting, Telangana CM Revanth Reddy highlighted welfare measures for women, farmers and unemployed youth, including recruitment for 72,000 government posts.

results.title: Aravali Express Assault Case: Thane Model Allegedly Attacks RPF Staff With Razor Over Reserved AC Seat, Released On Bail
results.description: Thane-based model Antara Soham Banerjee, 31, was arrested after allegedly attacking RPF personnel with a razor aboard the Aravali Express following a dispute over a reserved AC seat. She was deboarded at Dahanu, booked and later released on bail. Meanwhile, actress Antarra Banerjee’s PR team clarified that her photo was mistakenly used and she has no link to the case.

results.title: Odegaard says Arsenal ‘want to win everything’ after Community Shield win over Man City
results.description: Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard said the Premier League champion remains hungry for more silverware after opening the new season with a win over Manchester City in the Community Shield.
